LOOK │Pasay City traffic enforcer Ramero Hinojas, 60, directs traffic while wearing a Santa Claus costume at the corner of Macapagal Avenue and EDSA Extension in Pasay City today, just two days before Christmas. Motorists and passersby in the area are entertained by his unique gimmick, and his actions help ease the impatience of drivers and passengers.
